title: School Parent Meeting
subtitle: Talking with the teacher about your child — for English learners

sentences.en: Thank you for meeting with me today. How is my son doing in class?
sentences.target: Thank you for meeting with me today. How is my son doing in class?

sentences.en: Overall he's doing well, but I wanted to talk about a few things.
sentences.target: Overall he's doing well, but I wanted to talk about a few things.

sentences.en: His reading and math grades are strong, especially compared to last semester.
sentences.target: His reading and math grades are strong, especially compared to last semester.

sentences.en: That's great to hear. He's been working really hard on his homework at home.
sentences.target: That's great to hear. He's been working really hard on his homework at home.

sentences.en: However, I've noticed he's been quiet in group projects and doesn't speak up much.
sentences.target: However, I've noticed he's been quiet in group projects and doesn't speak up much.

sentences.en: He's a bit shy. At home, we've been trying to help him build his confidence.
sentences.target: He's a bit shy. At home, we've been trying to help him build his confidence.

sentences.en: That makes sense. Maybe I can give him smaller roles at first, then more responsibility.
sentences.target: That makes sense. Maybe I can give him smaller roles at first, then more responsibility.

sentences.en: That would be wonderful. Is there anything else we should be doing at home?
sentences.target: That would be wonderful. Is there anything else we should be doing at home?

sentences.en: Reading aloud together for fifteen minutes a day would really help his vocabulary.
sentences.target: Reading aloud together for fifteen minutes a day would really help his vocabulary.

sentences.en: We can definitely make that part of our evening routine.
sentences.target: We can definitely make that part of our evening routine.

sentences.en: Thank you for being so involved. It really makes a difference for the kids.
sentences.target: Thank you for being so involved. It really makes a difference for the kids.
